raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add `tests/test_supported_models.py`, which parses the model registry and the supported-models doc tables as plain text and asserts every documented architecture is registered, either as a registry key or as an implementation class name (the docs mix both, e.g. `NVLM_D_Model` is the class registered under the `NVLM_D` key).

## Claims

- Guards against docs-vs-registry drift of the kind previously fixed by hand (architectures listed in docs but missing from code, or vice versa).
- Stdlib-only: no torch, no vLLM import, no downloads, so it runs in any CI job.

## Validation

- `pytest tests/test_supported_models.py -v` locally: 2 passed.
- Negative control: with the documented exception removed, the test fails with exactly one architecture, `MiniMaxVL01ForConditionalGeneration`, so it is sensitive rather than vacuous.
- `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` clean.
- Also verified via the standard path (full repo conftest, no `--noconftest`): 2 passed.

## Details

- Only the docs-to-registry direction is asserted. The reverse is not: many registry architectures are legitimately absent from the docs (e.g. speculative-decoding draft models).
- Tables are parsed only between `## List of Text-only Language Models` and `## Model Support Policy`, which excludes the Plugins section (plugin models live outside the native registry by design).
- One documented exception: `MiniMaxVL01ForConditionalGeneration` is listed in the docs but present only in `_PREVIOUSLY_SUPPORTED_MODELS` (supported until v0.23.0). It is kept as an explicit exception so the stale row stays visible; removing it is a docs follow-up, not something to hide inside this test.

AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
This PR is not duplicating an existing PR: open PRs were searched for the covered area keywords on Oct 30, 2026, with no matches.

detail.title: [Test] Check supported-models docs against model registry

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+"""Docs-vs-registry consistency checks.
+
+Parses the model registry and the supported-models doc tables as plain text,
+so this test needs neither torch nor a vLLM import. It guards against the
+drift fixed by hand in the past: architectures listed in the docs must exist
+in the registry, either as a registry key or as an implementation class
+name (the docs mix both, e.g. ``NVLM_D_Model`` is the class registered
+under the ``NVLM_D`` key).
+"""
+
+import ast
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[1]
+REGISTRY = REPO_ROOT / "vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py"
+DOCS = REPO_ROOT / "docs/models/supported_models.md"
+
+DOCS_TABLES_START = "## List of Text-only Language Models"
+DOCS_TABLES_END = "## Model Support Policy"
+
+# Listed in the docs but no longer supported: MiniMax-VL-01 was supported
+# until v0.23.0 (see _PREVIOUSLY_SUPPORTED_MODELS) while its docs row
+# remains. Kept as an explicit exception so the stale row stays visible;
+# removing it is a docs follow-up, not something to hide inside this test.
+KNOWN_STALE_DOCS_ARCHS = {"MiniMaxVL01ForConditionalGeneration"}
+
+_EXCLUDED_REGISTRY_DICTS = {
+    "_PREVIOUSLY_SUPPORTED_MODELS",
+    "_OOT_SUPPORTED_MODELS",
+}
+
+
+def _registry_archs() -> set[str]:
+    tree = ast.parse(REGISTRY.read_text())
+    archs: set[str] = set()
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
+            continue
+        for target in node.targets:
+            if not (
+                isinstance(target, ast.Name)
+                and target.id.endswith("_MODELS")
+                and target.id not in _EXCLUDED_REGISTRY_DICTS
+            ):
+                continue
+            if not isinstance(node.value, ast.Dict):
+                continue
+            for key, value in zip(node.value.keys, node.value.values):
+                if isinstance(key, ast.Constant) and isinstance(key.value, str):
+                    archs.add(key.value)
+                if isinstance(value, ast.Tuple) and value.elts:
+                    last = value.elts[-1]
+                    if isinstance(last, ast.Constant) and isinstance(last.value, str):
+                        archs.add(last.value)
+    return archs
+
+
+def _docs_archs() -> set[str]:
+    lines = DOCS.read_text().splitlines()
+    start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() == DOCS_TABLES_START)
+    end = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() == DOCS_TABLES_END)
+    archs: set[str] = set()
+    for line in lines[start:end]:
+        if not line.startswith("|"):
+            continue
+        cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
+        if cells:
+            archs.update(re.findall(r"`([^`]+)`", cells[0]))
+    return archs
+
+
+def test_registry_and_docs_parse_succeeds():
+    # Guard against silent parser breakage: if either side parses to
+    # nearly nothing (e.g. a format change), fail loudly instead of
+    # passing vacuously.
+    assert len(_registry_archs()) > 300
+    assert len(_docs_archs()) > 200
+
+
+def test_documented_archs_are_registered():
+    unregistered = _docs_archs() - _registry_archs() - KNOWN_STALE_DOCS_ARCHS
+    assert not unregistered, (
+        "Architectures listed in docs/models/supported_models.md but "
+        f"missing from the model registry: {sorted(unregistered)}"
+    )
